description: This file contains conversion functions for Kubernetes API objects in the 'apps/v1' version, including Deployment, DaemonSet, StatefulSetSpec, and related structures. It handles conversion between internal and external representations, including handling deprecated fields and version-specific behaviors.

methods.name: Convert_apps_DeploymentSpec_To_v1_DeploymentSpec
methods.description: Converts an internal DeploymentSpec to a v1 DeploymentSpec, with auto-conversion fallback.

methods.name: Convert_v1_Deployment_To_apps_Deployment
methods.description: Converts a v1 Deployment object to an internal Deployment, handling deprecated rollback annotations.

methods.name: Convert_apps_Deployment_To_v1_Deployment
methods.description: Converts an internal Deployment to a v1 Deployment object, handling deprecated rollback annotations.

methods.name: Convert_apps_DaemonSet_To_v1_DaemonSet
methods.description: Converts an internal DaemonSet to a v1 DaemonSet, adding deprecated template generation annotation.

methods.name: Convert_apps_DaemonSetSpec_To_v1_DaemonSetSpec
methods.description: Converts a DaemonSetSpec with auto-conversion, no additional logic.

methods.name: Convert_v1_DaemonSet_To_apps_DaemonSet
methods.description: Converts a v1 DaemonSet to internal, handling deprecated template generation annotation.

methods.name: Convert_v1_StatefulSetSpec_To_apps_StatefulSetSpec
methods.description: Converts StatefulSetSpec, clearing apiVersion/kind in nested volume claim templates for <1.17 behavior.

methods.name: Convert_apps_StatefulSetSpec_To_v1_StatefulSetSpec
methods.description: Converts StatefulSetSpec, setting apiVersion/kind in nested volume claim templates for <1.17 behavior.
